exposure: neonatal brain injury on MRI (<2 weeks after birth)
brain injury on 3-month MRI (2-4 months after birth)
outcome: 18- to 24-month composite adverse outcome (cerebral palsy, neurodevelopmental delay, hearing/visual impairment, epilepsy)
cohort: The study included 63 infants diagnosed with perinatal asphyxia and neonatal encephalopathy, 28 of whom received cooling treatment.
finding: DGM abnormalities observed on 3-month MRI, following initial DGM abnormalities on neonatal MRI, were associated with adverse neurodevelopmental outcomes at 18-24 months, suggesting its utility in evaluating neuroprotective treatments.
